hero.motivationalText1: 🌍 For those who want to work in Japan. That one step will change your future.
hero.motivationalText2: 🎯 Employment, career change, career advancement—One Step fully supports your first step in Japan.
hero.welcomeDescription: Welcome to One Step Co., Ltd. We are a trusted partner providing paid job placement, language education, and cross-cultural support for international talent in Japan. We connect excellent talent from around the world with Japanese companies and fully support global career success.
hero.aboutTitle: 📘 What is One Step Co., Ltd.?
hero.aboutDescription: We are a 'bridge between people' connecting foreigners who want to work in Japan with reliable companies. Our mission is to support not just matching, but also 'culture,' 'goals,' and 'future.'

infoTitle.title: CEO Message
infoTitle.description:
One Step Co., Ltd. is a bridge connecting international talent with Japanese companies.
Through language education and life support, we create a future where foreigners can work and live with peace of mind.
infoTitle.highlightText: We wholeheartedly support each person's 'one step'.

message.educationContent:
Came to Japan from Nepal 14 years ago. Graduated from Aichi Bunkyo University after attending Japanese language school and vocational school.
Through work experience at Japanese companies, gained deep understanding of Japanese society, business manners, and culture.
Currently holds Japanese nationality and strives to become a 'bridge connecting Japan and foreigners,' supporting both job seekers and companies.
message.paragraph1:
As a foreigner who came to Japan, I experienced various difficulties including language barriers, cultural differences, and job searching.
Learning Japanese, job hunting, and workplace adaptation—none of these were easy paths, but overcoming each challenge has made me who I am today.
message.paragraph2: That's why I believe I can empathize with and support those who are about to work in Japan more than anyone else, understanding their anxieties and expectations.
message.paragraph3:
For companies as well, there are various concerns and challenges when hiring foreigners, such as lack of understanding about language, culture, and systems.
One Step Co., Ltd.'s mission is to carefully bridge these 'invisible walls' and 'misunderstandings' to realize trustworthy and secure matching.
message.paragraph4:
As someone who has already adapted to Japanese society, I provide not just simple job placement, but also meticulous support for new graduates and first-time workers in Japan,
focusing on 'post-employment retention' and 'long-term success.'
message.closingMessage: We wholeheartedly support each person's 'precious one step'.
